newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH C.BANK SELLS PLN 391 MLN NBP-BILLS.
newsitem.headline: POLISH C.BANK SELLS PLN 391 MLN NBP-BILLS.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland sold 51 million zlotys worth of 182-day NBP-bills and cut the minimum price to 90.91 from 90.93 on August 30, after Polish banks bid for 256 million of the bills, the central bank said.
It also sold 340 million zlotys of its 273-day bills and cut the minimum price to 86.89 from 86.93 on September 3, after banks bid for 751 million zlotys of the bills.
The average yield of the shorter paper inched down 0.03 to 19.68 percent and it inched up 0.05 to 19.88 percent for the longer paper.
